## Description
Please summarize the changes made in this Pull Request and provide context on the issue or requirement being addressed.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change adding functionality)
- [ ] Security fix / hardening
- [ ] Performance improvement
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Testing improvement

## Checklist
- [ ] My code adheres to the style guidelines of this repository.
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my code.
- [ ] I have commented my code where appropriate.
- [ ] I have updated relevant documentation (`README.md`, `ARCHITECTURE.md`, `SECURITY.md`).
- [ ] Backend tests pass (`pytest -v backend/tests`).
- [ ] Frontend tests pass (`npm run test:run`).
- [ ] Frontend lint passes with 0 warnings (`npm run lint`).
- [ ] Frontend build succeeds (`npm run build`).
- [ ] No secrets, API keys, or private environment variables are committed.
- [ ] Security defenses (SSRF protection, path traversal checks, resource bounds) remain intact.
